units.source_text: 三公主所生薰君，源氏曾托冷泉院照顾。

en.t: Lord Kaoru, born to the Third Princess, had once been entrusted by Genji to the care of Reizei-in.

units.source_text: 因此冷泉院对他特别关心。

en.t: For that reason, Reizei-in showed him particular concern.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后自己没有子女，常感孤寂，因此也真心地爱护他，希望自己年老后有个亲近的保护人。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu had no children of her own and often felt lonely, so she too cared for him sincerely, hoping that in her old age she would have a close protector by her side.

units.source_text: 薰君的冠礼就在冷泉院中举行。

en.t: Lord Kaoru's coming-of-age ceremony was held at Reizei-in.

units.source_text: 十四岁上二月里当了侍从，秋天升任右近中将。

en.t: In the second month of his fourteenth year he became a chamberlain, and in the autumn he was promoted to Middle Captain of the Right Guards.

units.source_text: 作为冷泉上皇的御赐，晋爵四位。

en.t: As a favor granted by the retired emperor Reizei, he was advanced to the fourth rank.

units.source_text: 不知为何如此性急，使他接连加官，立刻变了一个成人。

en.t: For some reason they were so impatient that office after office was added to him, and he was suddenly made into a grown man.

units.source_text: 冷泉院又把自己御殿近旁的房室赐给他住，室中布置装饰，均由冷泉院亲自指挥。

en.t: Reizei-in also gave him rooms near his own palace to live in, and personally directed every detail of their furnishings and decoration.

units.source_text: 侍女、童女及仆从，一律选用品貌优秀的人。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting, young attendants, and servants were all chosen from people of excellent appearance and character.

units.source_text: 一切排场，竟比皇女的居处更加体面。

en.t: In every respect, the arrangements were even more splendid than the residence of an imperial princess.

units.source_text: 冷泉院身边和秋好皇后身边的侍女之中，凡相貌姣好、性情温雅、姿色可爱的人，尽行调派到薰君那边。

en.t: From among the attendants serving Reizei-in and Empress Akikonomu, all those who were good-looking, gentle in temperament, and charming in appearance were transferred to Lord Kaoru's side.

units.source_text: 院和后竟把他看作上客，特别优待，务使他住得舒服，过得快活，喜爱这冷泉院。

en.t: The retired emperor and the empress treated him almost like an honored guest, giving him special favor and making every effort to ensure that he lived comfortably, passed his days happily, and grew fond of Reizei-in.

units.source_text: 已故太政大臣的女儿弘徽殿女御，只生一位皇女，冷泉院对她宠爱无比。

en.t: The Kokiden Consort, daughter of the late Chancellor, had borne only one imperial princess, and Reizei-in loved that princess beyond measure.

units.source_text: 但对薰君的优遇竟不亚于这位皇女。

en.t: Yet the favor shown to Lord Kaoru was no less than what was given to that imperial princess.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后对他的慈爱与日俱增。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu's affection for him grew stronger day by day.

units.source_text: 而在旁人看来，这也未免太过分了。

en.t: But to others looking on, this seemed rather excessive.
